title: Your first supabase-js select
why_it_matters: This is the bridge from SQL knowledge to app code.
explanation: supabase.from picks the table, select chooses columns like SQL's select, and order sorts. The call returns an object with data and error. Always handle both, because a failing query doesn't throw by itself.
code:
const { data, error } = await supabase
  .from("posts")
  .select("id, title")
  .order("created_at", { ascending: false });
try_it: Log data and error separately and break the table name on purpose.
